title: English Practice Quiz 0295
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.
